evidence: The ALD cycle consisted of dosing ferrocene (99% purity acquired from Alfa Aesar®) and high purity oxygen (99.9%) in alternate doses into the reactor at temperatures ranging from 367 °C to 534 °C. Ferrocene was delivered into the reactor using a 200 cc bubbler (Precision Fabricators Ltd.) heated to 60 °C and nitrogen was employed as a carrier gas. The reactor was then purged with nitrogen in order to remove any excess ferrocene and by-products.
